scope: Timer title/status/choice scaling and individual scroll reachability at default and largest Accessibility category on iPhone/iPad. Not universal assistive-technology acceptance.

original_failed_probe.conclusion: The original test does not guarantee an observation before the four-second product deadline; polling completion plus fixed sleep crosses the boundary envelope, not proof of product timer regression.

test_only_idle_timing_qualification.fix: Anchor second input to monotonic first dispatch, then observe >5s after first input returns and <3.8s after second input dispatch. Preserve product four-second deadline, 8s hide wait and real taps. Explicit controller-budget guards fail rather than silently moving the observation.
